label: M-01
resolution: MAX_BPS sub-case is owner-power (noted in C-01); zero-default sub-case is a deploy-ordering footgun. Net Low, carried in QA bundle.
title: slippageToleranceBps defaults to 0 at deployment and accepts MAX_BPS (10000) as a valid setting — zero default over-credits depositor principal while MAX_BPS silently discards all principal credits
description: At slippageToleranceBps=MAX_BPS (10000), every deposit credits zero principal while consuming real tokens — all deposited value is silently discarded from the accounting ledger. At default deployment value of 0, all withdrawals revert on any Curve AMM discount, making the strategy non-functional until owner configures the parameter.
impact: MAX_BPS path silently zeroes ALL depositor principal credits while consuming real tokens. Zero-default makes strategy non-functional from deployment until owner sets a non-zero tolerance. Halmos (SYMBOLIC-001) formally proves dust-loss at any non-trivial slippage setting.
attackPath: Owner path: owner calls setSlippageTolerance(10000) — valid per require(_bps <= MAX_BPS)
Subsequent deposit of any amount N: _creditedPrincipal returns N*(10000-10000)/10000 = 0
clientBalances[token][depositor] += 0 — depositor's principal is never credited
Depositor's funds (vault shares) are held by the strategy but the depositor has no accounting claim
Zero-default path: at deployment, slippageToleranceBps=0, creditedPrincipal=full nominal amount
Any withdrawal swap returning less than nominal (any real-world Curve discount) hits minOut > actual and reverts
Strategy is non-functional from deployment until owner sets a non-zero tolerance
newEvidenceVsL01: MAX_BPS path silently zeroes ALL depositor credited principal; Halmos formally proves dust-loss at any non-trivial slippage. Warrants severity re-evaluation of L-01 from Low toward Medium — this classification proceeds as M-01 (upgraded from L-01 Low baseline).

halmos_SYMBOLIC_001.counterexample: amount=4 wei, slippageBps=8192 (81.92%): 4*(10000-8192)/10000 = 7232/10000 = 0; depositor loses 4 wei with zero principal credited
halmos_SYMBOLIC_001.note: Also trivially: at MAX_BPS, amount*0/10000=0 for ALL amount.
